title: Claude Code expands with 5 MCP servers #claudecode #mcpservers #aiworkflow
description:
Claude Code becomes significantly more powerful with five MCP servers that expand it beyond a closed coding assistant into a live research, browser automation, and multimodal workflow tool.

Perplexity MCP adds real-time internet access inside Claude, Playwright lets it control a browser and test web apps, Firecrawl pulls entire websites into conversations for research and RAG, Glyph connects it to large networks of image and video generation models, and Chrome MCP links Claude to the tabs already open in Chrome.

Together, these MCP servers show how the Model Context Protocol is turning AI tools into connected operating layers for development, automation, and content workflows. The practical value is speed: less context switching, better live data access, deeper web interaction, and broader creative output directly inside Claude-based setups.
